pages.title: Concentration
pages.text: Ordinary potions go into an Alchemy Pot filled with Hexbrew Solvent. The ingredients you add decide how many can be merged at once, and each batch yields one bottle. Effects and durations are added together, matching effects at the same level merge their durations, and where the same effect appears at two levels only the stronger one takes hold. The finished brew takes the mixed color of the potions.

pages.title: Splash and Extension
pages.text: Witch Hexbrew you have already made can be turned into splash bottles with gunpowder. With redstone, flame cattail and blaze powder, Extension doubles the duration of a potion's effects, up to a maximum of 8 minutes; an effect already at 8 minutes or more cannot be extended any further. JEI lists the exact ingredients and requirements.
